name: after-work-sidehustle-planner
description: After-work side hustle planner that interviews your skills, time and capital, then matches and verifies the best direction from a real project library and delivers an executable 7-day plan.

displayDescription.en: Interviews your skills, time and budget first, matches and verifies the best after-work money-making direction from a real project library, then delivers an executable plan with a 7-day startup checklist.
displayDescription.zh: 先问诊技能时间与本金，从真实项目库匹配并核实最适合的下班赚钱方向，输出可执行方案与7天启动计划。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我下班后有3小时，想找个靠谱的副业赚钱，帮我匹配适合我的项目
defaultInitPrompt.en: I have 3 hours after work and want a reliable side hustle. Help me match a suitable money-making project.

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我盘点适合打工族下班做的赚钱项目，并核实哪些真实可行
quickPrompts.en: Help me shortlist money-making projects suitable for workers after work and verify which are truly viable.
